videos.label: Daniel Sroka discusses AFPD accountability with Benjamin Gorman

descriptionParagraphs.text: American Fork resident Daniel Sroka joins Benjamin Gorman to discuss his meetings with Mayor Bradley Frost and Police Chief Cameron Paul following the police encounters involving Reckless Ben and others.

Their conversation covers earlier AFPD cases, the chief’s responses to questions about the arrests and search warrant, body-camera muting and redactions, and the role of citizen participation in police oversight.

Gorman is a former co-owner, with his wife Chrystal Law-Gorman, of the Salem/Keizer, Oregon Bricks & Minifigs store involved in the LEGO consignment dispute that prompted Reckless Ben’s investigation.
